title: GlyphManifest
description: FL-4131 Phase 0: Versioned glyph manifest for extended-glyph identity contract. Declares all extended GlyphIds (>255) used by a content pack, their Unicode backing scalars or project cluster IDs, atlas page bindings, and coverage metadata. RFC8785 canonical serialization + SHA-256 hash is the bundle-identity signal (gates bundle_compile_identity_includes_glyph_manifest_hash / bundle_compiler_rejects_extended_glyph_without_manifest_hash).

_comment.description: Free-form documentation string. Ignored by the validator.

manifest_version.description: Schema version. Must be 1 for this schema.

font_id.description: Required for Phase 1+ when the manifest declares atlas pages. Human-readable font name (e.g., 'Roboto-Medium'). Combined with font_sha256 to lock visual identity.

font_sha256.description: Required for Phase 1+ when atlas pages exist. Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the source TTF/OTF file used to bake the atlas pages. Part of manifest_hash so font swaps invalidate downstream artifacts.

style_id.description: Optional style identifier for the font (e.g., 'regular', 'bold'). Reserved for future multi-style manifests.

supported_cell_sizes.description: Phase 1+ ladder of integer cell pixel widths the manifest is compiled for. The compiler emits one atlas page per size. Must be non-empty if present. Recommended ladder matches the CP437 font ladder (4,6,8,10,12,14,16,18,20,24,28,32,36,40).

profile_kind.description: Discriminator for the XP extended profile path. Must be 'extended_glyph_v1' for Phase 0 sidecars. Parsers reject unknown profile_kinds fail-closed.

content_pack_id.description: Opaque identifier for the content pack that owns this manifest. Used as provenance key in bundle compile identity.

fallback_glyph_id.description: Manifest-declared renderable replacement GlyphId for unknown/unresolvable glyphs. MUST be a real entry in 'entries' with full coverage data. Sentinels (GLYPH_ID_NONE=0xFFFFFFFF, GLYPH_ID_UNRESOLVED=0xFFFFFFFE) are invalid here — validators must reject them.

admission_set.description: Optional explicit admission allowlist. If present, only GlyphIds listed here may appear as extended glyphs in XP files that reference this manifest. Enforcement gate: bundle_extended_admission_set_enforced (Phase 1). If absent, admission is open within the content pack.

entries.description: All extended GlyphIds declared by this manifest. GlyphIds 0-255 (CP437 legacy contract) MUST NOT appear here — they have no manifest entry.

atlas_pages.description: Atlas page descriptors. Entries reference pages by index. If absent, atlas binding is deferred to Phase 1.

glyph_id.description: Project-assigned GlyphId. Must be > 255 (CP437 IDs 0-255 are not extended glyphs). Must not be a sentinel (0xFFFFFFFF GLYPH_ID_NONE or 0xFFFFFFFE GLYPH_ID_UNRESOLVED).

label.description: Human-readable identifier for tooling and debugging. Not a rendering value.

unicode_scalar.description: Optional Unicode scalar backing this GlyphId. Informational only — extended GlyphIds are project-assigned IDs, not raw Unicode codepoints in the runtime. Validators may use this for cross-reference but must not substitute it for the glyph_id.

cluster_id.description: Optional project cluster ID if this glyph belongs to a named repertoire cluster. Clusters allow grouping variant glyphs (e.g., regional digit variants) under a shared identity. Phase 1 feature.

atlas_page_index.description: Index into atlas_pages array. Required when atlas_pages is present. Absent means atlas binding is deferred.

atlas_uv.description: UV coordinates within the referenced atlas page [u_min, v_min, u_max, v_max] in normalized 0..1 space. Required when atlas_page_index is present.

cell_width_em.description: Cell width in em units. 1.0 = one standard CP437 cell width. Extended glyphs may be fractional or multi-cell (Phase 2+).

coverage_quadrants.description: 4-nibble quadrant coverage bitmask packed into a uint16. Nibbles: [NW, NE, SW, SE] from MSN to LSN. 0xF = full quadrant covered, 0x0 = empty. Required for all entries — governs CP437-compatible coverage blending in the render pipeline.

coverage_hint.description: Optional hint for coverage computation. 'full' means glyph covers the full cell; 'partial' means partial coverage (e.g., combining marks). Defaults to 'full' if absent.

page_id.description: Unique page identifier within this manifest.

path.description: Relative path from assets/glyphs/atlases/ to the atlas image file.
